storyChalet.title: Our story: Passion for paws
storyChalet.paragraph1: S&P Ring Pet Care was founded by Sarah with a simple mission: to treat every dog and cat as if they were her own family. Operating across Clarksville, TN, we offer reliable, personalized pet sitting and drop-in check-ups built on trust and absolute peace of mind.
storyChalet.paragraph2: We specialize in accommodating pets with complex routines or medical profiles—ensuring seizure medications are given exactly on time, twice a day, so you can travel without worry.

services.title: Dog & Cat Sitting
services.shortDescription: Overnight care in your home or ours to keep your pet relaxed and loved.
services.longDescription: We understand pets are happiest in their familiar environments. Our overnight pet sitting ensures your dog or cat keeps their standard sleeping schedule, morning walks, and feeding patterns intact.

faq.q: Do you watch dogs and cats of all breeds?
faq.a: Yes, we are highly experienced with dogs and cats of all shapes, sizes, and temperaments.

services.title: Dog Walking & Outdoor Exercise
services.shortDescription: Structured walking routes to keep your puppy active, healthy, and happy.
services.longDescription: We provide custom dog walking packages tailored to your puppy's physical endurance and age profile. Every walk includes fresh water refills, paw wipe-downs, and a detailed check-in report with route photos.

faq.q: Do you walk dogs in bad weather?
faq.a: Yes, but in extreme heat or severe storms, we will pivot to indoor mental play and shorter potty breaks to safeguard your dog.

services.title: Specialized Cat & Kitten Care
services.shortDescription: Feline-focused visits covering food setups, litter box maintenance, and laser play.
services.longDescription: Cats need stimulation and structured check-ins just as much as dogs. We provide specialized feline drop-ins focusing on refilling fresh water, scooping litter boxes, grooming, and interactive feather/laser play sessions.
features: Supervision for senior or shy cats

faq.q: How often should you visit my cat?
faq.a: We recommend at least one visit per day to ensure felines are safe, fed, and healthy.

services.title: Specialized Medication Support
services.shortDescription: Certified administration of critical timed pills, injections, and medical care.
services.longDescription: Our handlers are highly trained and experienced in administering complex pet medical routines. We handle twice-a-day seizure dosing timelines, insulin injections, and sub-Q fluid administration with extreme precision.

faq.q: Are you certified to give shots?
faq.a: Yes, we are highly experienced in standard subcutaneous injections for diabetic and senior pets.
